homeHelp: Suppliers, stock checks, budgets, purchase orders, and tenders for this school.
vendorsHelp: A supplier gets a portal login. The password is shown once. A current license is required to bid.
name: Supplier
passwordOnce: Portal login. Copy it now. It is not shown again.
requestsHelp: A store request is bought only while stock is still at the reorder level. A teacher request is refused when the store already holds the quantity.
budgetsHelp: A purchase is refused when the line is more than the amount still free. An approved line stays reserved until the order is issued.
title: Title
ordersHelp: An order is issued only after approval, and only to a supplier with a current license. Delivery cannot pass the ordered quantity.
emptyOrders: No purchase order has been issued.
emptyApproved: No approved request is waiting for an order.
tendersHelp: An open tender is listed on the public portal. The award goes to the lowest bid whose license is still current.
matrixHelp: The lowest amount is first. A tie keeps the earlier bid. An expired license cannot win.
portalHelp: Sign in with the username and password the procurement office gave you.
boardHelp: These tenders are open. Bid amounts stay private until the office compares them.
emptyBoard: No tender is open for this school.
